method: Arc-length-weighted geometric least-squares circle; segment midpoint quadrature.
cap_selection_policy: Clip S3-owned actual slice segments beyond a declared fraction of J3-to-distal-skin axial extent along prepared J2-to-J3 direction. The diagnostic reference fraction is 0.5; 0.4/0.6/0.7 expose selection sensitivity. These are historical comparison fits; the user-selected broad side arc is now the active envelope reference.
source_geometry: Actual coherent skin intersections from saved initial shared-hand poses; S3 is the existing trial section ownership classification. No convex hull replaces skin.
limits: Faceted skin is approximately circular over the selected side arc; no exact seating guarantee.
Original S3 retains all segments. The active side fit explicitly stops before the returning underside and terminal lip; old whole-cap fits remain comparisons.
Only Middle and Thumb were prepared; other digits are not inferred.
A material or skin-overlap allowance is not subtracted from the measured curve.
No runtime, anatomy resource, joint, pose, weapon, or grip acceptance rule changed.

side_arc_fit.selection_policy: Start at the positive-side open S3 boundary; follow the actual contour until its first reversal along prepared J2-to-J3. The annotated Right Middle side is explicit, not inferred as palm or dorsal.
